description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of tasks across different linguistic families. The vertical axis displays the linguistic family categories: IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque, listed in descending order. The horizontal axis is labeled '# tasks' and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Each linguistic family is represented by a horizontal bar of a distinct color; IE-Slavic is represented by a light blue bar extending to approximately 80 tasks, while IE-Romance is represented by a dark blue bar reaching approximately 60 tasks. IE-Germanic is shown with a light green bar at approximately 45 tasks, and Uralic is represented by a green bar at approximately 42 tasks. IE-Baltic has a pink bar extending to around 14 tasks, and IE-other is shown with a red bar at approximately 18 tasks. IE-Indic is represented by an orange bar at approximately 16 tasks, Semitic by a darker orange bar at approximately 12 tasks, Turkic by a light green bar at approximately 8 tasks, and Basque by a dark blue bar at approximately 5 tasks. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of tasks across various linguistic families. The vertical axis lists the categories, including IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque, arranged in descending order of task count. The horizontal axis is labeled '# tasks,' ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at intervals of 10. IE-Slavic exhibits the highest number of tasks, approximately 80, followed by IE-Romance at around 60 tasks. IE-Germanic and Uralic show similar task counts, both exceeding 40 tasks. Notably, IE-Baltic demonstrates a sharp decline compared to Uralic, with fewer than 15 tasks. Basque, the smallest category, has fewer than 10 tasks, showing a consistent trend of minimal representation across studies. The chart highlights a steady decrease in task counts from IE-Slavic to IE-Baltic, with a more gradual decline observed among the remaining categories.
